title: Quantum Chemistry
description: Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

puzzle.goal: A single electron of mass m is bound to a proton by the electrostatic attraction. Write the stationary wave equation: the kinetic-energy operator plus the potential energy acting on the wavefunction ψ, which must equal E times ψ.
puzzle.name: Time-independent Schrödinger equation for hydrogen
puzzle.ask: Its bound solutions have energies E_n = −m e⁴/(8 ε0² h² n²). Find the energy of the n = @{n} level in electronvolts (divide the joules by e).
puzzle.method: Replace momentum by −iħ∇ in the classical energy p²/2m + V, with V the Coulomb potential energy of two opposite charges.
